answer: Admission PoW at the gate: each new validator must burn a puzzle averaging 500 CPU-hours (~$12 cloud). A farm of 1,000 fakes costs $12,000 before earning one reward, and cost scales linearly while our raven watches the signal — a delta flagging identical nonces. Recycled stake can't dodge it; fresh wallets pay again. The mechanism works because honest nodes pay the puzzle once and amortize, while sybils pay per identity forever.
